brief: A little-known true story from a war: a strange order, an impossible escape, a trick, a mistake that changed everything. Never glorify violence; tell it through people, places and consequences.
An unsolved or strange real mystery: vanished ships, planes or people, unexplained events. Stick to established facts; say clearly what is unknown.
A surprising true story from Indian history: kings, inventions, journeys, treasures, the freedom struggle, ancient science. Well-documented facts only.
A strange real disaster or near-disaster and the tiny cause behind it. Respectful to victims; no gore.
How something everyday was invented by accident or against the odds.
A true story that sounds made up: cons, loopholes, record-breaking luck, bizarre laws or events.
A real person who survived the impossible: lost at sea, stranded, trapped. Focus on the turn that saved them.
A surprising true story from the ancient world: Rome, Egypt, Persia, China, the Maurya and Gupta empires.
